$comment: Scanner resource profiles for ephemeral workers (S4-C). Ceilings enforced by the worker runtime (S4-B); capacity-agnostic by design - no host-size assumptions. Owner: D3 (dwight). Bump policy matches tools.json (90-day review).

large.typical: dependency DB refresh + image/IaC scans, staged DAST crawls

notes: timeout_seconds is the hard SIGTERM->SIGKILL budget; grace period is worker-runtime-owned (S4-B contract).
pids_limit caps fork bombs before the abuse battery ever sees them; battery still asserts denial behavior.
Profile assignment may be overridden per scan_run by scheduler admission (S4-A) within these ceilings.
